text: 今天（7月23日）下午，国务院新闻办公室举行新闻发布会，介绍2026年上半年商务工作及运行情况。相关负责人介绍，上半年民营企业贡献近六成外贸增量，外资企业、国有企业进出口均实现了两位数增长。（央视新闻）
text_en: This afternoon (July 23), the State Council Information Office held a press conference to report on the business operations and performance in the first half of 2026. The responsible official stated that in the first half, private enterprises contributed nearly 60% of foreign trade growth, while imports and exports of both foreign-invested enterprises and state-owned enterprises achieved double-digit growth. (CCTV News)
